_help: Checks for the transcript name-removal rules (scripts/transcripts.py). Each case is a few caption lines (>> starts a new speaker, as in the real captions) plus words that must NOT appear in the result ('gone') and words that must still appear ('kept'). All names here are made up. When a name slips through on the site, add a case with the same pattern (never the real name) and fix the rule until it passes. Run: python tests/run_checks.py

cases.name: basic introductions and calls
lines: >> Vice Mayor Kearney: WE WILL NOW MOVE TO PUBLIC COMMENT. EACH SPEAKER HAS TWO MINUTES.
>> Vice Mayor Kearney: OUR FIRST SPEAKER IS JOHN SMITH, FOLLOWED BY MARY WILLIAMS.
>> GOOD AFTERNOON. MY NAME IS JOHN SMITH AND I LIVE IN NORTHSIDE.
>> Vice Mayor Kearney: THANK YOU, MR. SMITH.
